leads.title: Baskin v. Bogan - U.S. District Court / U.S. Supreme Court
leads.documents: Legalization and recognition of same-sex marriage in Indiana; June 25, 2014 ruling that ban unconstitutional and Oct 6, 2014 Supreme Court refusal to hear appeal
leads.detail: Cited as 'Baskin v. Bogan' with dates June 25, 2014 and October 6, 2014; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Hively v. Ivy Tech Community College - U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit
leads.documents: April 4, 2017 8-3 ruling that discrimination based on sexual orientation is discrimination on account of 'sex' under Title VII Civil Rights Act of 1964; establishes workplace protection binding in Illinois, Indiana, Wisconsin
leads.detail: Cited as 'Hively v. Ivy Tech Community College,' oral arguments Nov 2016, decision April 4, 2017; Ivy Tech stated would not appeal; Human Rights Campaign quote; no URL visible

leads.title: Indiana HB 1608 - Indiana General Assembly / Governor
leads.documents: May 2023 law prohibiting classroom instruction on 'human sexuality' K-3 and compelling schools to report in writing to parent if minor requests different name, pronoun, or title
leads.detail: Cited as 'Indiana HB 1608' signed May 2023 days after passage; no URL visible

leads.title: Indiana Senate Bill 480 - Indiana General Assembly / Governor Eric Holcomb
leads.documents: March 2023 ban on gender-affirming healthcare for minors under 18, emergency clause effective April 2023, ACLU lawsuit alleging Equal Protection violation, June 16, 2023 preliminary block, Feb 27, 2024 Seventh Circuit stay allowing ban to take effect, Nov 2024 appeals upheld
leads.detail: Cited as 'Senate Bill 480' with timeline July 1, 2023 cutoff and six-month wind-down; no URL visible

leads.title: Indiana House Bill 1569 - Indiana General Assembly / Governor Eric Holcomb
leads.documents: April 2023 ban on gender-affirming healthcare within prisons, specifically use of state/federal funds for 'sexual reassignment surgery to an offender patient,' effective July 1, 2023
leads.detail: Cited as 'Indiana House Bill 1569' signed April 2023; no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit - August 2023 bathroom injunction ruling
leads.documents: Federal judge upheld lower court preliminary injunction preventing Indiana schools from limiting bathroom usage of transgender students pending litigation
leads.detail: Cited as August 2023 federal judge / Seventh Circuit action; no URL visible

leads.title: Henderson v. Box - U.S. District Court / Seventh Circuit / SCOTUS
leads.documents: June 30, 2016 federal ruling requiring Indiana to list both same-sex parents on birth certificates, upheld unanimously by Seventh Circuit Jan 17, 2020 after AG Curtis Hill appeal, SCOTUS declined Dec 2020
leads.detail: Cited as 'Henderson v. Box' with eight plaintiff couples and 'presumption of parenthood' discussion; no URL visible

leads.title: Indiana Hate Crimes Law - Indiana General Assembly / Governor Eric Holcomb
leads.documents: April 2019 hate crimes law making intent to harm/intimidate based on perceived or actual characteristics an aggravating circumstance allowing harsher sentences, covering sexual orientation/gender identity without listing categories; prior bias-crime data collection since 2003 and federal Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Act coverage
leads.detail: Signed April 3, 2019; vagueness doctrine criticism noted; no URL visible

leads.title: Indiana Religious Freedom Restoration Act (RFRA) and April 2, 2015 clarification - Governor Mike Pence / The Indianapolis Star
leads.documents: March 26, 2015 RFRA signing and backlash (NCAA, Apple CEO Tim Cook, Gen Con, Disciples of Christ, Salesforce), and April 2, 2015 clarification that RFRA does not authorize refusal of services, facilities, goods, employment, housing or public accommodation based on sexual orientation or gender identity
leads.detail: Quoted via 'The Indianapolis Star' language on clarification; enacted July 1, 2015; no URL visible

leads.title: Governor Mike Braun Executive Order March 2025 - Indiana Department of Health / Bureau of Motor Vehicles
leads.documents: Defines sex solely as assigned sex at birth, directs Department of Health to no longer update gender markers on birth certificates (previously allowed 2014-2025 with court order), ACLU lawsuit, Feb 2026 BMV prohibition on gender-marker changes, end of 'X' marker offered March 2019-Jan 2020 and AG Curtis Hill March 2020 opinion
leads.detail: Cited as March 2025 executive order and Feb 2026 BMV implementation; related Rep. Bruce Borders 2017 bill effort; no URL visible
